Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the 3 cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include only either a card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait or a Tamer card with an inherited effect, can I just add that 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the 3 cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait and a Tamer card with an inherited effect, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Card Q&A.a: It means a Tamer card with "Inherited Effect" in its lower text. A Tamer card with a [Security] effect in its lower text isn't a "Tamer card with inherited effects."
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "Tamer card with inherited effects" mean, exactly?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait and 1 Tamer card with inherited effects among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand with the play cost reduced by 2.
